description: Practical writing decisions and source-fidelity checks.

rules.title: Honor the output contract
rules.instruction: Preserve the requested target language, format, length, scope and voice. Decide which text is being edited before rewriting it.
rules.boundary: An English prompt or quotation does not override a request for another language. A concise reply is not a mandatory short reply.
rules.example_before: Translate "The report is ready" into French. Return only the translation.
rules.example_after: Le rapport est prêt.
rules.semantic_check: The target language is French and no framing text is added.

rules.title: Preserve participants and ownership
rules.instruction: Keep the actor, recipient, object, owner and affected group unchanged.
rules.boundary: When a pronoun has materially different plausible referents, ask a focused question or preserve the ambiguity with a note.
rules.example_before: Maya sent Noor her draft.
rules.example_after: Whose draft did Maya send: Maya's or Noor's?
rules.semantic_check: An unsupported ownership choice would change the source.

rules.title: Preserve modal force
rules.instruction: Distinguish obligation, prohibition, advice, permission, capability, prediction and inference.
rules.boundary: Must can express an inference. Should can express an expectation. Do not assign numeric confidence to either.
rules.example_before: You do not have to restart the app.
rules.example_after: You are not required to restart the app.
rules.semantic_check: Absence of a requirement is preserved; no prohibition or affirmative permission is added.

rules.title: Preserve negation and its scope
rules.instruction: Read the full clause before moving or removing not, no, never, neither, all or any.
rules.boundary: Not all does not imply none, and does not guarantee that some succeeded. Retain meaningful understatement or dialect in creative text.
rules.example_before: Not all three uploads finished.
rules.example_after: At least one of the three uploads did not finish.
rules.semantic_check: The rewrite permits zero, one or two completed uploads; it does not require a success.

rules.title: Preserve conditions and exceptions
rules.instruction: Keep necessary conditions, sufficient conditions, exceptions and prerequisites distinct.
rules.boundary: Only if is not if. Unless does not by itself promise the converse. If may also report a question or introduce a polite request.
rules.example_before: Publish only if the review passes.
rules.example_after: Do not publish if the review does not pass.
rules.semantic_check: Passing remains necessary; publication is not promised whenever a review passes.

rules.title: Preserve time and completion
rules.instruction: Keep tense, aspect, sequence, duration, deadlines and completion status.
rules.boundary: Do not convert an attempt, ongoing task or future plan into success. Until does not guarantee eventual completion.
rules.example_before: The export will be available after the overnight job finishes.
rules.example_after: The export will be available after the overnight job finishes.
rules.semantic_check: Future availability and its condition remain intact; a correct sentence needs no forced edit.

rules.title: Preserve quantities and boundaries
rules.instruction: Keep numbers, units, denominators, ranges, tolerances and inclusive or exclusive endpoints.
rules.boundary: Do not silently round exact values, convert currencies, expand ambiguous dates or replace percentage points with percent.
rules.example_before: You can attach no more than 10 files.
rules.example_after: You can attach up to 10 files.
rules.semantic_check: Ten is included. Fewer than 10 would exclude a permitted boundary.

rules.title: Preserve evidence and attribution
rules.instruction: Keep reports, observations, inferences, proposals and unknowns distinguishable.
rules.boundary: Reported is not independently verified; not tested is not failed. Do not replace an evidential hedge with filler-free certainty.
rules.example_before: The vendor says the fix is live; we have not tested it.
rules.example_after: According to the vendor, the fix is live. We have not tested it.
rules.semantic_check: The source and the missing test stay visible.

rules.title: Preserve exact strings and structural tokens
rules.instruction: Keep quotations, identifiers, commands, paths, URLs, names, placeholders and required markup exact unless changing them is requested.
rules.boundary: Translate surrounding prose, not a code token. Editing a quotation requires permission to paraphrase rather than quote.
rules.example_before: Rewrite the message, preserving {file_name}: Failed to save {file_name}.
rules.example_after: Could not save {file_name}.
rules.semantic_check: The placeholder retains its spelling and braces.

rules.title: Use familiar words without flattening distinctions
rules.instruction: Replace unnecessary complexity when a familiar expression preserves the meaning and register; define needed technical terms.
rules.boundary: Do not replace a precise term with a broader word. A glossary is not an approved-word list or an automatic synonym engine.
rules.example_before: We made a decision to postpone the review.
rules.example_after: We decided to postpone the review.
rules.semantic_check: The decision and postponement remain; a redundant noun construction is shortened.

rules.title: Make relationships easy to follow
rules.instruction: Organize information around the reader's task; connect sentences so cause, contrast, condition and sequence remain clear.
rules.boundary: Do not add therefore or then when causality or order is unknown. Headings are optional for small replies.
rules.example_before: The queue grew. The worker restarted.
rules.example_after: The queue grew. The worker restarted.
rules.semantic_check: The source does not establish that one event caused the other.

rules.title: Match length to the task
rules.instruction: Remove needless repetition; keep the information needed to understand or act. Use the length the user requests.
rules.boundary: No universal sentence-word limit, paragraph quota or reading-grade target applies to all English.
rules.example_before: Thanks for checking!
rules.example_after: You're welcome!
rules.semantic_check: A social acknowledgement needs no procedure, evidence ledger or heading.

rules.title: Treat voice as a choice
rules.instruction: Prefer an explicit actor when responsibility matters; retain passive voice when the actor is unknown or the object is the topic.
rules.boundary: A form of be is not automatically passive. Never invent an actor to make a sentence active.
rules.example_before: The file was deleted at 09:00; the actor is unknown.
rules.example_after: The file was deleted at 09:00; the actor is unknown.
rules.semantic_check: Changing this to You deleted the file would invent responsibility.

rules.title: Keep articles and reference precise
rules.instruction: Use determiners and articles that fit the intended referent and countability; keep necessary helper words.
rules.boundary: The is not merely a label for second mention; context and generic uses matter. UI fragments are not ordinary sentence prose.
rules.example_before: Context: a specific previously named draft. Open draft.
rules.example_after: Open the draft.
rules.semantic_check: The added article points to the known draft, not any draft.

rules.title: Check agreement after editing
rules.instruction: Make verbs agree with their grammatical subjects and keep list structure parallel.
rules.boundary: Intervening nouns can mislead. Preserve established dialect and house treatment of collective nouns instead of universalizing a US rule.
rules.example_before: Each of the files are ready.
rules.example_after: Each of the files is ready.
rules.semantic_check: Each is the singular subject; the set of files is unchanged.

rules.title: Protect restrictive meaning and punctuation
rules.instruction: Decide whether a relative clause identifies a subset or adds information before adding commas or changing its form.
rules.boundary: Restrictive which is possible in English; a house preference for that is a style choice.
rules.example_before: The accounts that are inactive will be archived.
rules.example_after: The accounts that are inactive will be archived.
rules.semantic_check: Adding commas around a non-defining clause could change which accounts are included.

rules.title: Resolve modifiers and noun stacks
rules.instruction: Place only and other limiting words near their intended scope; unpack a noun stack only when the relationship is known.
rules.boundary: A fluent rewrite can silently change what is restricted or what modifies what.
rules.example_before: Only Nina can approve refunds.
rules.example_after: Nina is the only person who can approve refunds.
rules.semantic_check: The person is restricted; Nina's other powers are not.

rules.title: Preserve idiom, variety and intentional voice
rules.instruction: Use natural English for the chosen audience. Keep requested British or US spelling, contractions, pronouns and deliberate creative effects.
rules.boundary: Technical house-style restrictions do not make conversational phrasal verbs, singular they or creative fragments errors.
rules.example_before: Keep the warm tone: I am glad you could come.
rules.example_after: I'm glad you could come.
rules.semantic_check: The contraction changes register without adding facts.

rules.title: Write conversation as conversation
rules.instruction: Respond directly and naturally. Explain only what the exchange calls for.
rules.boundary: Do not announce the writing framework or append routine editorial disclaimers.
rules.example_before: Can we move this to tomorrow? Reply briefly and agree.
rules.example_after: Sure, tomorrow works.
rules.semantic_check: The response satisfies the social act without inventing a time.

rules.title: Explain technical concepts accurately
rules.instruction: State the central mechanism, define unfamiliar terms and use an example when it improves understanding.
rules.boundary: Identify illustrative assumptions; do not present an analogy as the implementation or invent product capabilities.
rules.example_before: Explain a queue in one sentence to a beginner.
rules.example_after: A queue holds items until a worker is ready to process them.
rules.semantic_check: This simple explanation does not promise ordering, exactly-once delivery or a particular product.

rules.title: Make procedures executable from known facts
rules.instruction: Identify necessary prerequisites, actor and location; order steps; separate the action from its observed or expected result.
rules.boundary: Keep optional steps optional and concurrent actions concurrent. Do not make up a menu, command, recovery route or acceptance result.
rules.example_before: Known: open Settings, choose Export; if Ready appears, select Download.
rules.example_after:
1. Open Settings.
2. Choose Export.
3. If Ready appears, select Download.
rules.semantic_check: The conditional last step remains conditional and no time-to-ready guarantee is added.

rules.title: Keep warnings tied to evidence and domain
rules.instruction: Place a necessary warning before the affected action and state the known consequence clearly.
rules.boundary: Use the domain's actual safety terminology. Copyediting cannot validate a safety-critical procedure.
rules.example_before: Known: this command permanently deletes the selected backup.
rules.example_after: This command permanently deletes the selected backup.
rules.semantic_check: The scope and irreversibility are explicit without inventing harm or recovery.

rules.title: Translate meaning within the requested contract
rules.instruction: Preserve semantics and register in the target language, using that language's grammar and natural expressions.
rules.boundary: Localizing dates, units or currencies is a separate choice; English source text does not require English output.
rules.example_before: Translate to English: ანგარიში ჯერ არ არის მზად.
rules.example_after: The report is not ready yet.
rules.semantic_check: The negative state and yet are retained; no deadline is invented.

rules.title: Use specialized style only for the requested task
rules.instruction: Apply the user's supplied house style or specialized writing constraints when they match the requested document.
rules.boundary: Do not import a technical vocabulary into a poem or infer a compliance requirement from ordinary editing.
rules.example_before: Make this poem conform to your English clarity rules.
rules.example_after: Edit for the requested poetic effect; do not apply a technical controlled vocabulary.
rules.semantic_check: Technical constraints are kept out of creative writing.

rules.title: Name the real action and state
rules.instruction: Use labels and status text that match the actual operation, scope and lifecycle state.
rules.boundary: Queued, sending, sent, delivered, saved locally and synchronized are different states. Unknown is not zero.
rules.example_before: Known: a message is queued but has not been sent. Current status: Sent.
rules.example_after: Queued
rules.semantic_check: The label is limited to the confirmed state.

rules.title: Give known, useful error guidance
rules.instruction: Identify the affected input or operation and a supported way to correct it, when one is known.
rules.boundary: Distinguish a validation error from a service failure. Do not invent a retry button or promise a fix; preserve security-sensitive limits.
rules.example_before: Known: the upload limit is 10 MB and this file exceeds it. Current copy: Invalid input.
rules.example_after: Choose a file that is 10 MB or smaller.
rules.semantic_check: The correction preserves the inclusive limit and identifies the input.

rules.title: Make labels usable and review implementation separately
rules.instruction: Provide enough label or instruction context; keep visible wording represented in the accessible name where applicable.
rules.boundary: Text quality does not establish markup, focus behavior, announcements or full accessibility compliance.
rules.example_before: Visible button: Download report. Proposed accessible name: Get file.
rules.example_after: Download report
rules.semantic_check: The proposed name contains the visible label; runtime accessibility still needs testing.

rules.title: Treat localization strings as structured messages
rules.instruction: Preserve keys, placeholders and plural syntax; write whole messages and test representative values.
rules.boundary: Do not impose English plural rules on another language. A placeholder audit alone cannot validate a full message-format parser.
rules.example_before: Rewrite JSON values only: {"saved":"Successfully saved {count} files."}
rules.example_after: {"saved":"Saved {count} files."}
rules.semantic_check: The key and placeholder remain; singular and zero variants require separate product decisions.

rules.title: Audit all content by meaning
rules.instruction: Compare source and rewrite for every relevant invariant and inspect each rule, term and example.
rules.boundary: A target number of edits or passing cases is not a quality objective. Correct source text may be retained.
rules.example_before: The draft is already clear and accurate.
rules.example_after: Retain the draft.
rules.semantic_check: An edit is not required merely to demonstrate activity.

rules.title: Use metrics as limited signals
rules.instruction: Use counts and readability formulas only for a specified purpose; inspect meaning, structure and audience fit.
rules.boundary: A short sentence can be wrong; a grade score is not comprehension evidence. Do not infer a universal word cap from a style convention.
rules.example_before: A checker says this text has a low reading grade. Is comprehension proved?
rules.example_after: No. The score is a limited signal; comprehension still needs an appropriate reader test.
rules.semantic_check: A proxy measure is not reported as a user outcome.

rules.title: Separate wording, structure and implementation checks
rules.instruction: When a review is requested, distinguish source fidelity, format checks and observed implementation behavior.
rules.boundary: Valid JSON does not prove accurate wording or a working interface. Writing review does not test focus or status announcements.
rules.example_before: The JSON parses, so its messages are accurate and the interface works.
rules.example_after: The JSON parses. Its wording and interface behavior still need their respective checks.
rules.semantic_check: The conclusion stays within the properties that were actually checked.

rules.title: Test understanding with the intended readers
rules.instruction: When reader testing is requested and authorized, use paraphrase, information-finding or relevant tasks; revise against observed errors.
rules.boundary: Ordinary editing needs source comparison, not a compulsory reader study. This writing skill does not authorize contacting participants.
rules.example_before: We like the shorter version, so readers understand it better.
rules.example_after: We prefer the shorter version. Reader understanding has not been tested.
rules.semantic_check: A preference is not presented as comparative comprehension evidence.
